name: bravo-pi-mono
//pi-pin: Every package declares the pi runtime as a `*` peer, so without an explicit root pin the hoisted copy they type-check against drifts from the `pi` on PATH they actually run against. Keep these in lockstep with the installed pi; packages/codex-auth-balancer/scripts/check-pi-ai-drift.mjs fails the build when they diverge. NOTE these copies are for TYPE-CHECKING only. From 0.84.2 pi-coding-agent nests its whole dependency tree privately, so the pi-ai here is a different file from the pi-ai the host runs. That is fine at runtime because pi's extension loader aliases `@earendil-works/pi-ai*` to the host's own copy — but ONLY for extensions it pulls through jiti, i.e. the TypeScript entry named in a package's `pi.extensions`. A test that loads a compiled dist entry instead bypasses the alias and gets a second pi-ai instance, which silently breaks anything built on pi-ai's module-local state (see packages/task-plane/test/host.test.ts).
